lane_title: Multi-Height Joint Gravity-Magnetic Cross-Gradient Persistence, Dispersed Geothermal Plume Intersection & Un-Damped Seamless LiDAR-Void Synthesis
single_method_paragraph: Construct 12 label-free HPTR physical channels combining (1) listric depth-scaled (150/400/800 m) joint gravity-RTP upward-continuation ridge persistence and cross-field strike co-alignment, (2) anisotropic +-45 deg upslope/updip advective-dispersive geothermal plume intersection across GDR 1391 2m temperature probes, paleo-geothermal sinter/travertine vents, geothermometers, and USGS heat-flow wells coupled with shallow RTP magnetite destruction, spectral magnetization decay, bilateral K/eTh alteration shoulders, and 2.5 km high-pass asymmetric MT clay-cap baffles, and (3) road- and shoreline-deconfounded seamless 10 m + 3 m USGS 3DEP scarp features variance-matched to the 1 m contour-orthogonal LiDAR specialist to bridge the 24.63% 1 m LiDAR void without damping range-front or bedrock faults; fuse out-of-quadrant LightGBM specialists with the un-damped Two-Regime Multi-Physics Conduit prior and fold-visible-only fault-tip/relay strike-tensor concordance via Noisy-OR, and emit 37,654 binary float32 [0,1] dots using 300 m submodular CELF with a multi-peer portfolio uniqueness cap (<=14,500 dots inside the 3-px halo of any prior KANLERGEMSDOE2 submission).

mandatory_gates.gate_1_format_and_range_0_1: Single-band float32 EPSG:32611 3730x3292 100m grid, nodata=None, 0 NaNs across 12,279,160 cells, values in [0,1], 0 positive pixels on existing_faults.tif.
mandatory_gates.gate_2_leakage_canary: Every single feature tested alone on spatially-blocked holdout must satisfy AUC <= 0.90 before fitting any model.
mandatory_gates.gate_3_uniqueness_detector_policy: Pre-placement surface |Spearman| < 0.90 and post-placement dots |Spearman| < 0.90 across ALL registry rasters (incl. controls), <= 0.70 directional 3-px dot overlap against EVERY competing geological detector across all focus, archive, and sister sites, AND <= 0.45 directional 3-px overlap against EVERY prior KANLERGEMSDOE2 GeoTIFF.
mandatory_gates.gate_3_literal_lattice_disclosure: Transparently log exact directional overlap against 13gems spacing-5 calibration lattice (U=6,649 uncovered px; unavoidable >=82.3418% lower bound at 37,654 dots) alongside control-separated verdict.
mandatory_gates.gate_4_holdout_superiority: Beat the 0.2778 Champion benchmark on ALL THREE holdout evaluators simultaneously (GEMSDOE32-HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0.1, GEMSDOE32-SGMC-CAL-v3.0, and GEMSDOE70-C-PIED-v1.0) with strictly positive paired 95% bootstrap CIs on Hide-Recover AND SGMC-CAL AND C-PIED.
mandatory_gates.gate_5_metadata: Unique submission filename + portal note <= 140 characters.
